lead.event: MSCI reclassification controversy and responses to the proposed downgrade of Indonesia
lead.headline: MSCI considers moving Indonesia to standalone status, decision due 30 June 2027
lead.blurb: MSCI’s consultation on the possible reclassification ends 30 April 2027. During it, the index provider is freezing increases to foreign inclusion factors and share counts, additions to the MSCI Indonesia Investable Market Index and upgrades to higher market-cap segments, while continuing removals for high shareholding concentration. MSCI cited concerns over investability, ownership transparency, governance and suspected coordinated trading. President Prabowo called the move an attempt to intimidate Indonesia, while former Trade Minister Muhammad Lutfi alleged GIC and Temasek pressured MSCI, allegations both investors denied.

market_structure_policy.event: OJK sanctions parties in DSSA, BREN, and CUAN capital-market cases
market_structure_policy.headline: OJK sanctions parties in DSSA, BREN and CUAN cases with Rp2.1 trillion in fines
market_structure_policy.blurb: SMT was fined Rp1.5 trillion for DSSA share manipulation, while AH Ltd and TC Pte Ltd received Rp500 billion and Rp100 billion fines over the BREN and CUAN IPOs. OJK also suspended two underwriting representative licenses for one year and three months, respectively, and delivered the sanction letters on 21 October.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Mitrabahtera Segara Sejati announces a share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: MBSS plans buyback of up to Rp200 billion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Mitrabahtera Segara Sejati plans to repurchase up to 42.17 million shares, or 2.41% of its issued shares, using internal cash. The buyback is scheduled to run from 22 October to 21 January.

earnings_guidance.event: Pembangunan Jaya Ancol reports a nine-month net profit decline
earnings_guidance.headline: PJAA reports nine-month net profit down 56.75% to Rp25.35 billion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Pembangunan Jaya Ancol's operating revenue slipped 2.09% to Rp781.77 billion, while operating profit fell to Rp116.8 billion from Rp164.28 billion. Basic earnings per share declined to Rp16 from Rp37.

earnings_guidance.event: Gunanusa reports nine-month net profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: GUNA reports nine-month net profit growth of 18.78% to Rp57.03 billion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Gunanusa's net sales rose 19.2% to Rp1.49 trillion, and basic and diluted earnings per share increased to Rp22.81 from Rp19.21.

earnings_guidance.event: Haloni Jane reports a third-quarter net profit surge
earnings_guidance.headline: HALO reports third-quarter net profit up 160.4% to Rp20.52 billion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Haloni Jane's sales edged up to Rp158.7 billion from Rp157.99 billion, while cost of goods sold fell to Rp119.22 billion from Rp133.59 billion. Its deficit narrowed to Rp15.14 billion from Rp35.66 billion.

earnings_guidance.event: Phapros reports a 541% first-half net profit increase
earnings_guidance.headline: PEHA reports 541% first-half net profit increase
earnings_guidance.blurb: Phapros’ sales grew 5.37% to Rp482.85 billion, led by over-the-counter products, while gross margin widened to 50.43% from 47.96%. Analyst Surya Rianto said PEHA trades below its three-year valuation averages, while management targets over 20% sales growth and double-digit net profit growth through end-2026.
